sample-input.label: Sample Input
sample-input.description: Any input type from HTML is supported here

options.unused: Put any props you would put in an HTML input here like min and max for ranges. For text, add json-friendly if you want to make sure the input text to be safe for json storage like key names

defaults.sample-input: Defaults are essential for filling in null values. Notice that subforms can't have a default key name or asset.
